description: [Compliance & counterparty] Check whether a person is a politically exposed person (PEP) during KYC/AML onboarding. Use when onboarding a customer, director or beneficial owner. Price: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/pep-screen

birth_year.description: Optional birth year to disambiguate (+/-1 year)

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country (citizenship or office), e.g. DE, US, FR

name.description: Full name of the person to screen

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: screen_pep
title: PEP Screening (Politically Exposed Persons) ($0.02)
